fact_check_verdict: Publish as a proposed study permit that drew objections by its November 2nd deadline. FERC has not ruled. Nothing is approved, built or proven. Post-deadline docket counts were unreadable and are not used.

claims.spoken: DeepGreen is a company based in Needham, Massachusetts.
requires: Applicant contact line lists Needham, MA.

claims.spoken: It asked the federal government for a permit to study an underwater data center in Cook Inlet.
requires: Study permit only. Not a construction approval.

claims.spoken: The plan has sixty-six data center pods on the seabed.
requires: Notice says 66 modular subsea-compute hives (data center pods). AI is the applicant's characterization.

claims.spoken: They would run on about three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty tidal turbines.
requires: Proposed only. Do not depict installed hardware.

claims.spoken: The estimate is a hundred megawatts, mostly for the data center.
requires: Notice: 100 megawatts primarily to power the subsea data center. Never restate as MWh.

claims.spoken: A three and a half mile cable would land at Nikiski.
requires: 115 kV hybrid power and fiber cable, proposed.

claims.spoken: The deadline for objections was five p.m. Eastern on November second.
requires: 60 days fell on Saturday October 31st, extended to Monday November 2nd.

claims.spoken: A preliminary permit lets the holder study the site and claim priority, and nothing more.
requires: Notice: sole purpose is priority to file a license application; does not authorize land-disturbing activities.

claims.spoken: The company's own words were, a preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything.
claims.on_screen: "A preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything." LOUIS WOLFSON, DEEPGREEN
claims.verbatim_source: "A preliminary permit doesn't give us permission to build anything."
requires: Alaska Journal of Commerce via ADN, Oct 4 2026.

claims.spoken: The Kenai Peninsula Borough mayor, Peter Micciche, called the approach sloppy.
claims.on_screen: "Sloppy is the way I would describe this approach" MAYOR PETER MICCICHE
claims.verbatim_source: "Sloppy is the way I would describe this approach at this stage in the game,"
requires: Alaska's News Source, Oct 28 2026. On screen may be an excerpt of the sentence start.

claims.spoken: He says he hasn't had an email, letter or phone call from the company.
claims.on_screen: NO EMAIL, LETTER OR CALL, HE SAYS
requires: Reporter's paraphrase. Never in quotation marks. Attribute to him.

claims.spoken: DeepGreen answered that it was too early to reach out, before the engineering and biology work is done on paper.
claims.on_screen: COMPANY: TOO EARLY TO CONTACT OFFICIALS
requires: Reporter's paraphrase of Wolfson email. Do not quote.

claims.spoken: Commercial fishermen's alliance says more than thirteen hundred active permits could be affected.
requires: Attribute to the Alaska Commercial Fisheries Conservation Alliance; its objection says the proposal did not assess effects on more than 1,300 active permits.

claims.spoken: Cook Inlet belugas have been listed as endangered since two thousand eight.
NOAA's best estimate is three hundred thirty-one whales.
requires: Median best estimate, range 290 to 386, from the 2021 and 2022 surveys per NOAA, published June 2023.

claims.spoken: In nineteen seventy-nine there were about thirteen hundred.
requires: NOAA: declined nearly 80 percent from 1,300 whales (1979) to 279 (2018).

claims.spoken: The Alaska Energy Authority's chief told the Anchorage Daily News in August it was extremely disappointing to be bypassed.
requires: Secondhand via Nature World News citing ADN, August. Medium confidence. Paraphrase on air, do not put in quotation marks.

claims.spoken: The Center for Biological Diversity filed to intervene.
requires: ANS reports it filed to intervene. Do not state a date.
Absence as of reporting through Oct 28; FERC eLibrary was unreadable on Nov 10. Say 'hasn't ruled yet' only.
